verdict.rationale: The core flows are programmatic and fit unattended automation. Coding agents can provision an anonymous sandbox with working API keys via `stripe sandbox create`, with no account registration. `mppx validate` checks discovery, challenges, error handling and the full payment flow end-to-end. Catalog imports run through an API with completion webhooks, and restricted keys scope what an agent can do. However, Link CLI spends need per-request customer approval, and some MCP write actions need human confirmation, so not every flow can run fully unattended. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, a fully unattended path for Link wallet spends and gated MCP writes, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
